description: Rate a public Thalovant hub from 1 to 5 and return the updated hub. Requires the hubs:write scope; no paid plan is needed, so free-tier tokens can rate. Rating a non-public hub fails 400 "Only public hubs can be rated." and rating your own hub fails 400 "Hub owners cannot rate their own public hubs."

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_set_hub_rating
title: Set Hub Rating
